story.title: Bringing Ancestral Flavors Straight to Your Doorstep
story.desc1: Phum Yeung Restaurant operates as a specialized culinary kitchen designed to make authentic heritage Khmer cooking effortless to enjoy anywhere without leaving your home or office.
story.desc2: Without the compromises of walk-in dining, 100% of our focus goes into ingredient freshness, meticulous cooking, eco-friendly heat-insulating packaging, and rapid hot delivery.

about.title: About Phum Yeung Restaurant
about.subtitle: Cambodia's premier restaurant bringing authentic flavors directly to you
about.heritage_desc1: Phum Yeung Restaurant is created with a mission to make Cambodia's finest heritage recipes accessible to everyone, anywhere in Phnom Penh.
about.heritage_desc2: By operating solely as a delivery-focused kitchen, we invest 100% of our energy into sourcing organic farmer produce, authentic recipe development, sanitary temperature-controlled packaging, and rapid logistics.
about.mission_point1: 100% organic herbs and local produce supporting Cambodian agricultural families
about.mission_point2: Eco-friendly insulated packaging keeping curries and soups steaming hot
about.mission_point3: Fast contactless delivery with instant digital payments via Bakong KHQR
